description: This Java class 'ScreenFactory' is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model' package and handles loading, caching, and rendering 'ModelScreen' objects from XML screen definition files. It provides methods to parse screen files from different locations, extract screens by name, and facilitate rendering of referenced screens within the OfBiz framework.

classes.name: ScreenFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading, caching, and rendering screen models from XML files, supporting different resource locations and web application contexts.

methods.name: isCombinedName
methods.description: Checks if the given combinedName string contains a '#' indicating a composite name of a location and screen name.

methods.name: getResourceNameFromCombined
methods.description: Extracts the resource location part from a combined name string.

methods.name: getScreenNameFromCombined
methods.description: Extracts the screen name part from a combined name string.

methods.name: getScreenFromLocation
methods.description: Loads a ModelScreen object from a combined location and screen name.

methods.name: getScreenFromLocation
methods.description: Loads a ModelScreen from a resource name and screen name.

methods.name: getScreensFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves all screens from a specified resource location, parsing the XML if not cached.

methods.name: getScreenFromWebappContext
methods.description: Loads a ModelScreen from a web application's context given resource and screen name.

methods.name: readScreenDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to build a map of ModelScreen objects.

methods.name: renderReferencedScreen
methods.description: Renders a screen, either from a combined name or location, into a writer, handling errors appropriately.
